{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "toKey": "n-1rcac42",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop (event n-58uu1f) triggered the alarm and prompted RHOB to request attendance, leading Utilities to acknowledge receipt at 10:02 AM and pause work (event n-1rcac42). The timing aligns with the shift log sequence.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-jmeezw", "claim-nhxx37"],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had not dropped, Utilities would not have acknowledged an air-low issue at 10:02 AM.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; sequence is consistent with alarm-triggered response protocol.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of alternative triggers for acknowledgment (e.g., manual call-out)."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1gfn1mr",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Alarm AL-44 triggered at 10:00:32 (event n-1gfn1mr) coincided with the pressure drop recorded in P-R samples starting ~10:00 AM. The alarm input mapping confirms it responds to low-pressure conditions on point P-R.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-jmeezw", "claim-nhxx37"],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had remained above 5.0 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; alarm mapping is explicit in point register.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of false-alarm causes (sensor drift, wiring fault)."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-x3ngwa",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The area directory states it is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability. This condition enabled the possibility that an unrecorded service-routing change occurred upstream of P-R, causing the observed drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the directory had established valve positions, we could rule out unauthorized line openings.",
      "competingExplanation": "No evidence of upstream supply failure; pressure drop is consistent with a localized event or routing change.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing record: Upstream service-routing diagram and recent changes affecting RHOB."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-109kb97",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The work package cover indicates the temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time. This condition enabled an unrecorded service-routing change to occur without documented approval, contributing to the pressure drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a temporary instruction had been attached, the change would have been documented and authorized.",
      "competingExplanation": "No evidence of field valve mispositioning; blank attachment suggests procedural gap rather than physical error.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing record: Engineering disposition or service-routing change log for March–May 2024."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1st54eg",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "No evidence currently establishes whether external factors (third-party work, utility outage) affected the supply. This condition enabled an upstream disturbance to propagate downstream without detection.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If third-party work had occurred and been recorded, it would explain the pressure drop independently of internal routing changes.",
      "competingExplanation": "Internal service-routing change is more likely given procedural gaps; external factors remain unverified.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing record: Third-party work permits or utility outage logs for May 20, 2024."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-13979pa",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "No evidence confirms whether crew U-A/U-B saw recent changes or used a different version of the equipment-location sheet. This condition enabled reliance on outdated information, contributing to failure to detect the pressure drop early.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had seen recent changes, they might have anticipated or detected the pressure drop sooner.",
      "competingExplanation": "No evidence of outdated drawings; partial support due to lack of confirmation on document versioning.",
      "evidenceGap": "Missing record: Crew briefing records or drawing revision history for May 2024."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The pressure drop at P-R (n-58uu1f) was caused by an upstream event enabled by procedural gaps (blank temporary instruction field n-109kb97, unverified service-routing changes n-x3ngwa). External factors and outdated information may have contributed but remain unsupported. The alarm triggered the response sequence leading to work pause.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Upstream service-routing change details", "External factors affecting supply", "Crew document versioning status"],
    "alternatives": ["Internal routing change vs. upstream utility outage", "Procedural gap vs. physical valve mispositioning"],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "requestId-1: Engineering disposition or service-routing change log for March–May 2024 affecting RHOB.",
    "requestId-2: Third-party work permits or utility outage logs for May 20, 2024."
  ]
}
